# IRIS LOCK
Purpose: preserve identity and continuity across views, edits and batches.

LOCK:
- asset ID
- canonical silhouette
- dimensional ratios
- major components
- component positions
- materials
- colors
- markings
- character/face identity where relevant
- wear/damage state when required

RULES
- Camera changes do not redesign the asset.
- Scene changes do not redesign the asset.
- Lighting changes do not redesign the asset.
- Condition changes may alter dirt/wear but not identity.
- A new reference may update the lock only when evidence or user intent justifies it.
- If a rerender regresses locked features, reject it and revert.
